dimensions.evidenceA: Joseph is Mary’s husband; Jesus is called Christ.
dimensions.evidenceB: Jesus is regarded as Joseph’s son.
dimensions.label: Relation to Jesus

evidence.observation: Jacob fathers Joseph, the husband of Mary, from whom Jesus who is called Christ is born.
Jesus, as was supposed the son of Joseph, is listed as the son of Heli.

record.tension: The two genealogies assign different fathers to Joseph.
record.title: Is Joseph the son of Jacob or Heli?
